Overview

I've always been intruiged by the Fibonacci sequence and the pattern of finding spirals all throughout nature and the universe. I wanted to capture that concept in a series of drawings showing that the same pattern can emerge on virtually all scales. A seashell, reptile's tail, an aloe plant, an ocean wave, an angry hurricane, all the way up to a spiral galaxy. Spirals are everywhere the more you look.

Process / Additional Notes

Based on various reference photos edited to match the same scale & form. Each drawn on 3" x 3" drawing paper cutouts.
